language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the map, ISO 639-1 (default en): labels, search names, Wikipedia and Wikidata in it where they exist. A --name with a language segment (osm_fr_...) must agree.

title.title: ZIM title
title.description: Title of the ZIM (at most 30 characters)

description.title: ZIM description
description.description: Description of the ZIM (at most 80 characters)

long_description.title: ZIM long description
long_description.description: Long description of the ZIM (at most 4000 characters)

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Name of content creator. Default: OpenStreetMap contributors

file_name.title: ZIM filename
file_name.description: ZIM file name, without .zim; {name}, {period} (YYYY-MM) and {flavour} are replaced. Default: {name}_{period}, or {name}_{flavour}_{period} with --satellite

tags.title: ZIM tags
tags.description: Semicolon (;) delimited list of tags to add to the ZIM

illustration_url.title: Illustration URL
illustration_url.description: URL (or path) of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG (SVG needs zimscraperlib, as in the Docker image) used for the ZIM illustration. Default: a generated map icon

output.title: Output
output.description: Output folder for the ZIM. Default: ./output

stats_filename.title: Stats filename
stats_filename.description: Path to store the progress JSON file to

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Keep temporary files (the build log is always verbose)

area.title: Preset area
area.description: A preset area from create_osm_zim.py's KNOWN_AREAS, e.g. monaco

include_poly.title: Include poly
include_poly.description: URL of a .poly file bounding the area. A Geofabrik URL also selects its OSM extract; otherwise give --pbf-url

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat. For an area across the antimeridian, minlon > maxlon (Fiji: 172.8,-23.2,-176.5,-11.2)

pbf_url.title: OSM extract URL
pbf_url.description: OSM extract (.osm.pbf) to build from. Default: the Geofabrik extract of --area / --include-poly

mbtiles_url.title: MBTiles URL
mbtiles_url.description: URL of an OpenMapTiles MBTiles (e.g. OpenFreeMap's) to use instead of generating tiles with tilemaker: downloaded into the download folder (resumed if interrupted, reused while unchanged upstream), or a file:// URL used in place. Tiles outside the area are left out. See docs/zimfarm.md

no_routing.title: No routing
no_routing.description: Leave out offline routing (on by default)

max_zoom.title: Max zoom
max_zoom.description: Maximum zoom of the vector tiles. Default: 14

zim_workers.title: ZIM workers
zim_workers.description: Compression threads for libzim. Default: --cpus, else the usable cores within any CPU quota, at most 20

cpus.title: CPU cores
cpus.description: CPU cores the build uses at once (tilemaker, search, terrain, compression). Set it to the task's CPUs: a CPU share hides no cores, and each core costs memory. Default: the usable cores, at most the container's CPU quota and one per 2 GiB of its memory limit

tilemaker_store.title: tilemaker store
tilemaker_store.description: Where tilemaker keeps the extract's nodes and ways while it makes the tiles: memory, or disk (a folder in --tmp, 1.8 to 2.2 times the size of the extract cut to the area, removed afterwards; as fast in the measurements, and the Netherlands took 0.65 GB instead of 4.0). Default: auto, disk when the cut is over 1 GiB or tilemaker's estimated memory is over half the container's memory limit, unless --tmp has less than 3 times the cut free (disk then fails)

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Feature set: full: Wikidata, Wikipedia articles, Overture Maps, terrain, POIs in Kiwix search; basic: none of them (routing is on in both). Default: full

wikidata.title: Wikidata
wikidata.description: Wikidata place details (needs network access to Wikidata). Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia articles
wikipedia.description: English Wikipedia articles for the places that have one, stored in the ZIM (CC BY-SA). Text from the Wikipedia API, or text and images from --wikipedia-zim-url. Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

overture.title: Overture Maps
overture.description: Overture Maps addresses and place details (websites, phones, brands, categories), read from Overture's public S3 bucket over HTTPS. Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.description: Hillshade and 3D terrain from the Copernicus DEM (downloads DEM tiles for the area). Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

kiwix_poi_pages.title: POIs in Kiwix search
kiwix_poi_pages.description: Also list every named POI in Kiwix's own search, not only places, parks, peaks, water and airports. Adds about 440 B per POI (+16% on Luxembourg). Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

wikipedia_zim_url.title: Wikipedia ZIM URL
wikipedia_zim_url.description: Kiwix Wikipedia ZIM (download.kiwix.org) to read the articles and their images from instead of the API. Downloaded for every task: a full English one is 50 to 120 GB. Default: none (the API, text only)

wikipedia_images.title: Wikipedia images
wikipedia_images.description: With --wikipedia-zim-url: which of each article's images to store. none: text only; lead: the first picture (the infobox or top image, about 10 KB an article); all: every picture up to 12 an article (about 35 KB an article: German Switzerland, 25,800 articles, stores 884 MB of images, a quarter of the ZIM). Default: all

overture_release.title: Overture release
overture_release.description: Overture release, e.g. 2026-09-23.1. Default: latest (the newest complete release)

satellite.title: Satellite imagery
satellite.description: Add a satellite imagery layer (a Satellite button in the viewer). Off by default. The source defaults to s2cloudless-2016, CC BY 4.0; the ZIM's Flavour becomes 'satellite'. --satellite-source and --satellite-max-zoom also turn it on

satellite_source.title: Satellite source
satellite_source.description: Satellite imagery source (implies --satellite). s2cloudless-2016: EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016, CC BY 4.0, free for any use with attribution (softer, bluer, some seams). s2cloudless-2021: EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2021, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, NON-COMMERCIAL use only (sharper); needs --satellite-accept-noncommercial and labels the ZIM as restricted (Flavour 'satellite-nc', tag 'non-commercial'). Default: s2cloudless-2016

satellite_accept_noncommercial.title: Accept non-commercial imagery
satellite_accept_noncommercial.description: Required with a non-commercial --satellite-source (s2cloudless-2021), refused without satellite imagery: confirms that this ZIM may be used and redistributed for non-commercial purposes only

satellite_max_zoom.title: Satellite max zoom
satellite_max_zoom.description: Maximum zoom of the satellite tiles (implies --satellite; the viewer over-zooms past it). Default: --max-zoom, and at most 13 for areas centred 45 degrees or more from the equator
